scope: Browser phoneme-driven lip synchronization with on-demand speech geometry and local Kokoro synthesis. Broader hyperrealism remains open.
implementation: Model phoneme timings validated and embedded in a bounded optional JEVS RIFF chunk; ordinary WAV playback preserved.
Facial assets prepare without mutating the figure; only the winning playback attaches them.
The audio clock drives bounded overlapping visemes, while blink controls and body skeletons remain independent.
Inactive oral meshes stay hidden, and an invisible body also hides the oral anatomy. Speech updates after character wish effects.
Completion, mute and close release over 120 ms; blur/hidden-page suspension disposes immediately.
All ordinary character models remain the startup assets; speech variants load only on demand.
